draft_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training.
revised_text: Wrenfold outperforms Fennick-Base on the unseen test sets of the Banking and Travel domains on which it was trained.
rationale: The claim suggests generalization to unseen domains, but only Banking and Travel (the training domains) were evaluated. No unseen-domain data exists. The evidence only shows Wrenfold outperforms Fennick-Base on the two evaluated domains.
